result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Sparkling may assign to affiliates and transaction successors without consent; Garman requires Sparkling’s consent, subject to a reasonableness standard, and may never assign to a Sparkling competitor; and Sparkling’s change of control creates no termination right. Section (c) also preserves the separate restrictions on transferring, leasing, exporting, or sublicensing the Work. The redline is not strictly minimal because it additionally permits partial assignments and reorganizations, expands the asset-sale exception to a business-line sale, and bars suspension and repricing as well as termination. The residual mutual-assignment sentence is also somewhat redundant, though consistent with the preceding provisions.
